description: First-run and fallback values for user preferences. DataStore is the source of truth after the first write, so these values apply only before a setting is stored (docs/02-architecture.md).

preferences.notes: The learner chooses a daily goal; no value is assumed before onboarding.
Session length is chosen together with the daily goal.
Hangul is an optional phonetic aid. It stays off until the learner enables it; pinyin is always shown.
Eyes-free mode is an option, not the default.
Consent is explicit and revocable and stays false until the learner grants it. See ../legal/consent.md.
The accepted consent text version. 0 means no consent on record; the current text is version 1 in ../legal/consent.md.
